authorized_by: requester (project owner), explicit instruction in session
purpose: Train and validate the six-month voluntary attrition model on person-month rows so that multiple feature blocks can be evaluated together; aggregated cells exceed the 1000-row query cap with more than ~5 categorical features.

scope.population: Employee, Regular, active_status=1, is_rf360_yes_no=0, eng_or_noneng='Engineering' per monthly snapshot
scope.rows_in_memory: person-month feature rows and labels, held only in the Python process during training/validation
scope.identifiers: employee_id is never selected; at most a per-query pseudonymous surrogate is used in memory for grouping (dedupe, cluster bootstrap) and discarded with the process

non_negotiable_controls.published_outputs: aggregate groups only, minimum 30 people per snapshot and 30 events for observed rates

interpretation: Processing in memory is permitted; what the audience sees remains group-level. Every run manifest must cite this authorization and declare employee_level_rows_persisted=false.
